title: Best Dog Food (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were chosen from the 2026 reviews on HolisticDigest.com, HealthExtension.com, BusinessInsider.com, and ConsumerReports.org. Picks were ranked by how many sources mentioned them and by the strength of the evidence presented.
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no cost information is provided.

verdict.line: Picture a senior dog eating a tasty, nutrient‑dense raw meal that keeps its coat shiny and digestion smooth. We Feed Raw delivers the most nutrient‑dense ingredients and the best value among the tested brands, making it ideal for dogs needing a high‑quality raw diet. The catch: it requires refrigeration and careful handling.
